title: The Beauty of Uncertainty: The Rise of Insurance Contracts and Markets in Medieval Europe
lineage: Inspected the indicated passage; the local file contains paraphrased research notes. Independently checked slide 32 via the indexed archived object version; original manuscript not inspected.

passages.note: Researchers summarize a 25 February 1347 Palermo–Pisa insurance contract, 100 gold florins insured at 7.5%, identifying Francesco di Canigliano as insured and Baldassarre Grillo as insurer. The archive original was not inspected.
